name: js-py-workbench
description: Monorepo combining a JavaScript web app with a Python FastAPI service using pnpm

scripts.dev: node -e 'import("node:child_process").then(({ spawn }) => { const procs = ["dev:py", "dev:web"].map((s) => spawn("pnpm", ["run", s], { stdio: "inherit" })); const stop = () => { for (const p of procs) p.kill("SIGINT"); process.exit(0); }; process.on("SIGINT", stop); process.on("SIGTERM", stop); });'
scripts.test: pnpm run test:js && pnpm run test:py
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:js && pnpm run lint:py
scripts.lint:js: pnpm --filter @repo/web run lint && pnpm exec eslint packages/js_helpers
